lines.trans: Quiet everyone, I need complete silence!
Chef, we have already turned off all noisy equipment.
Be quiet, I demand absolute calm in the kitchen.
All the cooks fell silent and are standing in place.
Do not breathe, I want to hear every quiet sound.
Are you sure our little guest is here?
She definitely hid somewhere in this dining room.
I hear a strange faint rustling near the table.
Who is standing there near the big refrigerator right now?
There is no one there, only large boxes of groceries.
Look carefully, the girl is sitting right under the table!
What joy, we finally found our missing one!

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('absolute, complete').

examples.text: Молчать, я требую абсолютного спокойствия на кухне.
examples.trans: Be quiet, I demand absolute calm in the kitchen.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('big, large').

examples.text: Аракелян просит время. Сумма очень большая.
examples.trans: Arakelyan is asking for more time. The sum is very large.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: И, Марина Сергеевна, читайте всё внимательно! Особенно мелким шрифтом!

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.en: to switch off, turn off (device, light)

examples.trans: The subscriber is switched off! What a nightmare!
Don't forget to turn off the light.

meanings.note: Manner/predicative adverb in '-о', derived from the neuter short form of the corresponding adjective.

examples.text: Где-то здесь была, а теперь нет.
examples.trans: It used to be somewhere here, and now it's gone.

examples.text: Все внимание! Гостья пробует блюдо новичка.
examples.trans: Attention everyone! The guest is tasting the newcomer's dish.
The guest is tasting the newcomer's dish.

meanings.note: Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to breathe'.

examples.text: Лёша, что случилось? Дыши, сынок, дыши!
examples.trans: Lyosha, what happened? Breathe, son, breathe!
Understood. And who is managing the dining room?

meanings.note: Prefix 'за-' marks beginning an action, covering, or stopping by along the way (stem 'молчать'). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to fall silent, shut up', paired with 'молчать'.

examples.trans: Shut up and stop frightening us.
Turn up the volume on the television, please.

examples.text: Не дышать, я хочу слышать каждый тихий звук.
examples.trans: Do not breathe, I want to hear every quiet sound.

meanings.note: emphasis: вот поэтому ты и... = that's exactly why you...

examples.trans: I was born and grew up here.

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.

examples.text: Аркаш, мне москвичи звонят каждый день. Может, всё-таки передумаем?
examples.trans: Arkasha, the people from Moscow call me every day. Maybe we should reconsider after all?

meanings.note: in exclamations: какой грязный! = how dirty!

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!
examples.trans: Look, how dirty our toilet is!
We were putting it into boxes.

examples.text: Шалфей был. Мы его в коробки клали.
examples.trans: It was sage. We were putting it into boxes.

And the kitchen is over there.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('light, easy, faint').

examples.text: Я слышу странный лёгкий шорох возле стола.
examples.trans: I hear a strange faint rustling near the table.

examples.text: Зато мы быстро заработали лёгкие деньги.
examples.trans: On the plus side, we quickly earned easy money.

meanings.note: Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('small, little').
на его место = in his place

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

молчать.gloss: to be silent, to say nothing

meanings.en: to be silent, to keep quiet
meanings.note: почему ты молчишь? = why aren't you saying anything?

examples.text: Ну что ты молчишь? Ты толстый, ты не спортсмен!
examples.trans: Well, why are you so quiet? You're fat, you're no athlete!

meanings.note: нас = us (gen/acc/prep); у нас = we have, at our place

meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)

examples.text: Смотрите, какой у нас грязный унитаз!

meanings.note: Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'to find', paired with 'находить'.

examples.text: Ну где я сейчас найду грузчиков?

meanings.note: Prefix 'на-' marks surface contact, accumulation, or completing a quantity (stem 'конец').

examples.text: О, наконец тепло! Слава богу. Сейчас ещё чай сделаю.
examples.trans: Oh, it's warm at last! Thank goodness. Now I'll make some tea too.

meanings.note: наш, наша, наше, наши; agrees with the noun

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates
+ genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice
needs 'не' with the verb: никто не войдёт

examples.trans: I know the town like nobody else.

examples.text: Садитесь и держите дверь. Никто не войдёт.
examples.trans: Sit down and hold the door. Nobody will come in.

meanings.note: short form 'нужен / нужна / нужно / нужны' + dative: 'мне нужна работа' = I need a job

examples.trans: To wait for about an hour.

meanings.note: Prefix 'про-' indicates movement through, completion, or missing the mark (stem 'пажа'). Common feminine noun meaning 'loss, missing thing' in everyday Russian.
